name: Garden Dou Dizhu
description: A three-player Dou Dizhu mini-game for your local LAN, with public/password rooms and animated characters. No hosted online service, online accounts, top-ups, payments or cash-out.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial public release: local LAN three-player rooms, optional passwords, animated characters, offline voices and social effects. Includes no hosted Internet lobby, matchmaking, online account service, top-ups, payments, purchases, cash-out or real-money stakes. Room beans are non-transferable score counters without monetary value. Windows x64 and macOS 15.4+ Apple Silicon/Intel unsigned review candidates; DBX Store signs approved packages.

zh-CN.name: 田园斗地主
zh-CN.description: 本地局域网三人联机斗地主小游戏，支持公开房、密码房和动态角色互动；无公网在线服务、账号、充值、支付或提现。
